name: Josh's rig, wash bar excluded (2026-09-14)
description: Same as josh_rig.json (laser@1, par@21, moving head@36) with the wash bar slot removed -- the real OK-103 unit is showing unpatterned strobe-channel flicker with the software confirmed sending a clean zero (session-20260914-171223), pointing to a hardware/DMX-line issue (missing/loose 120 Ohm terminator, marginal cable, or the fixture itself) rather than a software bug. Use this rig temporarily while that fixture is out of the chain for repair; switch back to josh_rig.json once it's fixed.
